name: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
assumptions: Yield estimated from 2 chicken breasts + 6 tortillas scaled to 6 modest adult portions of layered casserole
Total time sums active prep/shredding/layering (~20 min) + covered simmer (20 min) + bake (20-30 min, using 25 min midpoint)
Enchilada sauce treated as tomato-based with possible thickeners; no explicit wheat/soy but null for soy due to common commercial additives
Cheese confirms milk allergen and dairy incompatibility
Corn tortillas and plain chicken confirm absence of wheat, fish, shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts
No eggs or sesame listed or implied
instructions:
Cut each chicken breast in about 3 pieces, so that it cooks faster and put it in a small pot. Pour Enchilada sauce over it and cook covered on low to medium heat until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. No water is needed, the chicken will cook in the Enchilada sauce. Make sure you stir occasionally so that it doesn't stick to the bottom.
Remove chicken from the pot and shred with two forks.
Preheat oven to 375 F degrees.
Start layering the casserole. Start with about ¼ cup of the leftover Enchilada sauce over the bottom of a baking dish. I used a longer baking dish, so that I can put 2 corn tortillas across. Place 2 tortillas on the bottom, top with ⅓ of the chicken and ⅓ of the remaining sauce. Sprinkle with ⅓ of the cheese and repeat starting with 2 more tortillas, then chicken, sauce, cheese. Repeat with last layer with the remaining ingredients, tortillas, chicken, sauce and cheese.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes uncovered, until bubbly and cheese has melted and started to brown on top.
Serve warm.

ingredients.name: Enchilada sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 14 oz (397g) jar of red enchilada sauce; typical canned/jarred values used as no water added and most is absorbed or remains in dish

ingredients.name: shredded Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.assumptions: 3 US cups (340g) shredded Monterey Jack cheese; standard packaged shredded cheese density and nutrition

ingredients.name: corn tortillas
ingredients.assumptions: 6 standard 6-inch corn tortillas (40g each); typical yellow corn tortilla values

ingredients.name: chicken breasts
ingredients.assumptions: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (approx 170g each raw); typical USDA raw chicken breast values; cooked and shredded in sauce but base nutrition from raw edible portion
